answer: Use a terraced bond: every new agent starts on the lowest terrace with capped earnings, and climbing requires locking a refundable copper-token bond for a full epoch while surviving peer re-checks at each step. At dawn of each epoch the terrace resets rewards for the unverified, while bonded agents keep earning. A sybil attacker must fund each fake identity with its own bond and wait out every lock, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds plus weeks of waiting; one caught fake forfeits its bond, making the attack far pricier than the rewards it can harvest.
